profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Goals:  
1.  Looking for a startup company where a need of a one-man show to design and implement completely all factory systems.
2.  To seek a full-time position where I can maximize my skills in developing, implementing and managing factory systems including manufacturing executive system (MES), factory information system (FIS) and statistical process control (SPC).

12 years of experience in MES, FIS, SPC and Web reports using VB.NET, C#, Java, JavaScript.

Specialties: MES, FIS, SPC, Microsoft office: excel, powerpoint, access database, SQL server, Visio, Project Management, Oracle database, factory data warehouse, webMethods and BIRT.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and implement factory information system (FIS) & SPC.

positions.title: Sr. Developer Analyst
positions.description:
1.  Implement and maintain MES, AM (Asset Management) and E10 tool states to multiple FABs.
2.  Design and develop plug-and-play MES Web portal reports using JSP and BIRT.
3.  Design and develop SPC Web portal interface.
4.  Integrate data exchange from MES to Navision and SAP.
5.  Implement, design, and develop integration solution using webMethods (IS, TN, Broker, JDBC adapter, SAP adapter, and My webMethods) allowing many external and internal clients to communicate to central hub via RosettaNet and/or flat file.
6.  Design and develop completely new interface using .Net, ReportViewer and Telerik component to  capture webMethods errors where the interface would be friendly, eye-catching and aligning with business needs to use without any technical knowledge about webMethods.

positions.title: .NET Software Engineer
positions.description: Enhance and design different systems including Experiment Tracking, SPC, Quality System and many Web interfaces from VS2003 to VS2010.  In addition, migrating these systems from Informix to Oracle 11g using .NET report viewer and .NET charting.

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description:
Manage MES business team to provide the best solution based on customer requirements.
Manage MES development team using Java and .NET 
Manage Tableau servers.
Manage all testing in MES using QFS prior releasing to production.
Qualify all tools communicating to MES system.

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description:
Be a very first person to work with Eyelit software development toolkit (SDK) from ground zero and build a brand new team to enhance MES system in-house to provide faster turn-around time.

Completely architect the material control system (MCS) including define all automation messages between MCS and MES, automatic dispatching material to tools based on priority, WIP type, grade of material, and aging material from one step to next step.  The protocol has been a truly automated system without intervention of any operator inside factory.

Provide solution for durable/carrier management system in MES

Re-architect all the automation messages between tools to MES system to improve the response time and lessen the amount of history information in MES database to support mass production.

positions.title: Application Senior Analyst
positions.description:
Design and implement front-end user interface for Enterprise Data Collection System
Design tables structure for criteria selection in the reports.
Interview users to obtain best application usability.
Coach and facilitate in the use of Ajax to offshore team.
Design and architect Experiment Tracking System
SPC:  completely being a one-man show of global SPC system from data collection to reporting in many language including PowerBuilder, C++, VB.NET, ChartFX, and Java

positions.title: Intranet Web Developer
positions.description: Built one stop web site where all the information related to manufacturing can be found such as daily inventory, QA data, FA data, New Product Launch information, Shift pass-down of each process in the factory, morning meeting presentation, all machines cycle time (unit per hour-UPH), shiftly/daily/weekly/quarterly yield, etc.  A system where entire factory depends on to view daily activities.
